motion.reducedMotion: Animations are enabled only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .mm-primary { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #1c2422; border-radius: 4px; background: #1c2422; color: #ffffff; font: 600 13px/1.4 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .mm-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e7a4a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Money Input
components.css: .mm-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #1c2422; font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .mm-field span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .mm-field input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid #dde1dc; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #1c2422; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .mm-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e7a4a; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Action Menu
components.css: .mm-menu { box-sizing: border-box; width: 210px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid #dde1dc; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgb(28 36 34 / 14%); font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .mm-menu button { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 7px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #1c2422; font: 400 13px/1.4 inherit; text-align: left; } .mm-menu button:hover, .mm-menu button:focus-visible { background: #f4f6f2; outline: none; } .mm-menu .is-danger { color: #c03a2d; } .mm-menu hr { margin: 5px 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #dde1dc; }

components.name: Form Panel
components.css: .mm-panel { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 16px 14px; border: 1px solid #dde1dc; border-radius: 10px; background: #f4f6f2; color: #1c2422; font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .mm-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .mm-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #e3e7e0; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; } .mm-row span { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Money Map Paper
components.css: .mm-paper { box-sizing: border-box; width: 660px; min-height: 510px; padding: 32px; background: #fcfcfa; color: #1c2422; border: 1px solid #dde1dc; font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .mm-paper header p { margin: 0 0 4px; color: #47504d; font-size: 14px; } .mm-paper h1 { margin: 0 0 28px; font: 600 30px/1.3 'Literata', Georgia, serif; } .mm-account { width: 240px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #2f6bab; border-radius: 10px; background: #f2f7fc; } .mm-account span { color: #2f6bab; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .mm-account h2 { margin: 8px 0 14px; font: 600 19px/1.3 'Literata', Georgia, serif; } .mm-account strong { font: 600 25px/1.2 'Literata', Georgia, serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.northStar: A carefully prepared advisor working paper whose map remains more prominent than its controls.
principles: The money map is the product.
